blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-ops-1 (Payment call has no timeout) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-ops-2 (Unbounded retry of a non-idempotent charge) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Pass an explicit `timeout=` (connect and read) to `requests.post`. Without it, when the provider accepts the connection but stops answering, `charge()` blocks forever on the checkout path; the operator sees stuck checkouts and worker threads, with no error and no log to point at the provider.
findings.title: Payment call has no timeout

findings.recommendation: Bound the retries (a small maximum, with exponential backoff) and make the POST idempotent before retrying it — send an idempotency key derived from `order_id` if the provider supports one, otherwise do not retry once the request may have reached the provider. As written, a 4xx (declined card, bad amount) is retried every second forever, hammering the provider; and a 5xx or a dropped connection after the provider recorded the charge triggers another POST that charges the customer twice. Re-raise once the retries are exhausted.
findings.title: Unbounded retry of a non-idempotent charge

findings.recommendation: Log each failed attempt with structured fields — `order_id`, attempt number, HTTP status, exception type — and never the request body beyond those fields. Today, when the provider fails or rejects a charge, nothing is logged and no error surfaces, so the operator cannot tell which orders are failing nor why.
findings.title: Payment errors are swallowed without a log

findings.recommendation: Read the provider URL from the environment or configuration. The task was verified against the provider's sandbox, which differs from production; with the URL baked in, pointing an environment at the sandbox or at production requires a code change, and a test or staging deploy can send real charges.
findings.title: Provider URL hard-coded
